about_the_game:
In the darkness of your room, you start with a seemingly harmless game on your phone. But whenever you open a drawer in the game, it creaks open in your actual room, blurring the line between digital and reality. This game-within-a-game experience begins in a single room and spreads throughout your entire house as the tension multiplies.

“Nightmare Spiral” is inspired by analog horror elements and unfolds within a psychological horror atmosphere. Every move you make has real-world consequences, creating a one-of-a-kind interactive terror experience.

Are you ready to be scared?

short_description: You’re playing an innocent game on your phone in a dark room, but every drawer you open and every step you take in the game echoes in the real world. A unique, interactive horror experience where psychological terror and a game-within-a-game concept gradually ratchet up the tension.
